newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds mostly higher in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds mostly higher in slow trade.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly higher on Monday, but buyers were not tempted.
"The market remains slow with just a few odd loads going on here and there," said one broker.
High protein soymeal was offered one to three stg up ex-mill while stores were around one stg higher.
Rapemeal from the Erith mill was one to two stg down while Liverpool and Hull prices were one stg up. The remainder of the market was unchanged.
In light trading high protein soymeal fetched 229 stg for spot ex-store Tilbury while Brazilian 48 percent protein soymeal fetched 212 stg a tonne ex-store Teignmouth.
